statement: Generate a study module on any topic. Pass its quiz at 70%. The pass is recorded on the Sepolia testnet — verifiable on Etherscan.
metamaskNote: Requires the MetaMask browser extension — sign-in is a wallet signature.

ledger.caption: What your ledger looks like after a few attempts.

pipeline.step1Body: MetaMask signature. No email, no password.
pipeline.step2Title: Name a topic and a level
pipeline.step2Body: The module and its quiz are generated for you.
pipeline.step3Body: Grading runs on the server. Explanations for missed questions stay locked until a retake earns them.
pipeline.step4Body: A queue writes the pass to the Sepolia testnet. You can leave the page while it registers.
